workflow.name: Feature launch kit
workflow.description: Compliance check, store listing copy, launch article and growth plan for a new feature.

steps.prompt:
We are launching this feature: {{input}}

List the legal and compliance considerations (privacy/data, consent, app store policy, advertising claims, accessibility, regional rules) and the exact wording or changes required before launch.

Create a 2-week launch growth plan: channels, one viral loop idea, a referral or in-app prompt, metrics to track daily and the decision rule for doubling down. Use this launch article as the core message.
